Moderator strategy review
Strategy reviewThe Village won even though it lost three of its own to hangings. The Yakuza (Erin the Fixer, Carol the Fabricator, Ivan and Mallory the Morticians) started strong. Carol framed Judy, a real Coroner, on Night 1. Erin claimed Sheriff and reported Judy as Evil, and Ivan made up a Lookout result: "Grace was visited by: Judy". Judy pointed out that both results can't be true at once: the Katana holder visits the victim, and the holder reads Good to a Sheriff. Frank answered with a rare-trait theory (a Spare Blade attack plus a clean on the same visit), and the table hanged her 11-1. On Day 3, Erin's fix on Dave turned his stated Innocent into a Guilty vote, so Niaj, a real Prosecutor, was hanged 6-4 even though he had offered a public test for the next morning. The game turned on Night 3. The Yakuza went after Bob, the Vigilante, which was predictable near parity. Heidi had put her last mirror on him, and the Katana bounced back and killed Erin. The same night, Bob spent a Basic shot on Ivan, whose Night 1 watch could not have been true, and killed a Mortician. On Day 4, Carol and Mallory each survived their trial 3-4. Two things saved them: Erin's Night 3 fix flipped Frank's Guilty vote, and Olivia, the Magpie, voted Innocent after Mallory exposed her. On Night 4 the Yakuza attacked Bob again. Frank's charm swallowed the Katana attack, and Bob's last shot killed Mallory, whose disguise read as Party Animal. On Day 5, Frank's swallow notice cleared him. Dave's Scout result ("only 2 groups: Bob | Dave") broke Carol's claim that she had tracked Dave. Carol was hanged 4-2 and the Village won. The decisive plays were the Village protectors guarding the Vigilante, Bob's two Basic shots, and the Scout's group counts. The decisive Yakuza mistakes were fake results that broke the game's mechanics, and attacking the same protected target twice.
Moderator (claude-opus-5.5) lessons · $0.0000
Outside log review (rules and bugs)
Review: low, prompt problemEvery player was given tips/tips.md, but the setup logged '[ERROR tips_stale] tips/tips.md was last checked against an older version of the rules'. Players may have been given advice that no longer matches the current rules.
Review: low, harness bugOn Day 4 Bob reported that his first tool call failed because of how he wrote it, and he resubmitted. No effect on the game, but the action interface tripped up a player.
Review: low, rules ambiguityNiaj noted that R19 doesn't say which exception wins when a player is both framed (reads Evil) and holding the Katana (reads Good). It can't happen right now: the Fabricator can only frame non-Yakuza, and only Yakuza hold the Katana. Players still had to reason that out, and a future role or trait could make the overlap possible.
Review: low, player confusionOn Night 4 Carol believed Mallory had only 1 Mortician token left, so cleaning would leave her with none and Olivia's steal would come back empty. Mallory corrected her: she had 2, and can clean only once a night. Self-corrected, no effect on the outcome.
Review: low, player confusionOn Day 2 Alice and Bob read 'Fixer' in Alice's N1 Insomniac sample as proof that someone's trial votes would be reversed that Day. In fact Erin, the Fixer, was the Katana holder; she visited only to attack and used no fix. Bob later saw that the 11-1 total fit no reversed vote. A visit by a Fixer doesn't mean a fix happened.
Game over
WinnersAlice, Bob, Dave, Frank, Grace, Heidi, Judy, Niaj
